rationale: Builds directly on the best reverse recurrent-tail baseline by adding a learned per-block anchor refresh inside the reverse tail loop. The carry anchor is no longer frozen for the whole recurrent pass; each repeated tail block can retarget it toward the updated hidden state, which may preserve the close local signal from anchor-refresh variants without a large rewrite or extra export complexity. The change is compile-stable, compact, and adds only a tiny control tensor that should survive the current quant-aware endgame.
title: Per-Block Tail Anchor Refresh
